carrier: 64-dimensional F2 sign cohomology of the triangle-filled GQ(4,2) point graph
affine_origin: the all-odd edge signing; each triangle has odd edge sum and the signing is fixed by every graph automorphism
theorem: The affine binary sign-sector moduli admit an exact group quotient without enumerating 2^64 vectors. Translation by the all-odd PGSp-fixed solution identifies the affine space with the faithful 64-dimensional linear sign-cohomology module. Burnside gives 711679993497112 PSp orbits and 355840805040988 PGSp orbits. Because the global linear fixed space is zero, the all-odd signing is the unique fully PSp-fixed and unique fully PGSp-fixed affine sign sector.
boundary: This closes the binary sign-sector quotient. The independent 225-dimensional twisted F3 deformation/projective moduli are a separate characteristic-three problem.
